claims.statement: UK guidance requires remote licensees to monitor financial, time, behavioural, and account indicators for harm.
The Commission recommends high online-gambling consumer protection and recognizes account-based behavioural tracking.

contrary_evidence: Large operators have extensive internal data and national rules differ.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: responsible-gambling consultants and compliance leaders.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 40 operators at 200000 PLN yield 8 million PLN ARR and founder equity above 5 million PLN in six years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 15-20 hours weekly with harm-science and privacy advisers.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: 75% after audits and validation.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 100000-300000 PLN annually plus 0.05-0.20 PLN per active player month.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: network benchmarks and recurring evaluation discourage churn.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Each member improves rare-pattern and intervention-outcome coverage
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: On-premise federated risk models and intervention evaluation
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operator pays annually for model updates and benchmarks
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An operator must identify risky play across sparse edge cases

founder_fit: Gambling familiarity and quantitative skills align, but enterprise trust-building is demanding.
risks: Biased models could harm vulnerable players.

structure.control_point: Membership, common intervention taxonomy, and cross-operator outcome benchmarks
structure.critical_dependency: Multiple operators accepting shared labels, governance, and privacy controls

thesis: A privacy-preserving federated cooperative lets licensed gambling operators improve harm detection without pooling raw player data.
title: SaferPlay Cooperative
uncertainties: Minimum viable consortium size and federated uplift are unknown.
